scope: Native entity, tick and heightmap kernels; related JNI and selected actual Java callers

candidates.title: Native pathfinder mirror retains every visited section without a size or unload bound
candidates.severity: medium if reachable through sustained same-world player-induced long mob paths
candidates.confidence: high on unbounded retention, medium on security relevance, player-controlled workload not dynamically verified
candidates.root_cause: Persistent thread-local native unordered_map inserts 4096-cell section payloads without LRU, byte/section budget, TTL, or chunk-unload hook. A one-upload-per-tick budget limits allocation rate only.
candidates.attacker: Potential ordinary player inducing repeated long mob path requests across new loaded regions in the same world; no arbitrary JNI/plugin caller assumed.
candidates.control: Player influences mob destinations and traversed loaded terrain; cannot directly select counts or native pointers. Generated source statically confirms Zombie player targeting to MeleeAttackGoal to PathNavigation to PathFinder native hook; generated sources were not rebuilt against patches.
candidates.impact: Accumulating native memory survives Java chunk unload and is outside Java heap accounting; sustained growth could exhaust process/native memory. Native allocation inside noexcept could terminate on allocation failure. No practical exhaustion rate established.

counterevidence: A native request for another world on the same thread clears the complete mirror. Active mobs in multiple dimensions may reset it each tick.
More than 4096 invalidations between mirror reads cause complete clearing; mutations of retained sections evict those sections.
Short paths <=24 Manhattan, regions with horizontal maximum axis <32, volume<8192, unsupported/dynamic shapes, and unloaded snapshot cells prevent upload.
Native availability and ABI compatibility required; operator may disable nativePathfinder or set warmup budget<=0.
Java PathfinderTickStateCache caps itself at 512 sections, but that is a separate cache and does not cap native map.

Generated upstream sources are ignored by normal rg inventory; subsequently read them explicitly. Runtime ordinary-player reproduction remains unverified. PathNavigationRegion only provides cached chunks, so snapshot extending beyond that region falls back. Same-height diagonal offset13,13 passes the Manhattan24 gate with distance18.4<Zombie FOLLOW_RANGE35; at favorable chunk alignment native snapshot fits cached chunks.
candidates.remediation: Add native per-thread/per-world section or byte budget with LRU/TTL eviction and unload invalidation. Ensure coverage/search safely falls back when eviction creates gaps. Add bounded memory-growth tests for repeated disjoint snapshots. Catch native allocation failure before noexcept boundaries. Until fixed disable nativePathfinder if observed native memory growth.
candidates.validation_not_performed: No runtime reproduction, ASan, crash, memory-growth measurement, or exploit execution.

hardening_observations.issue: Native region-volume and output-size arithmetic may overflow for malformed direct JNI inputs
hardening_observations.disposition: NativePathfinder Java validate uses Math.multiplyExact/addExact before normal native calls; no runtime player bypass established.

hardening_observations.disposition: No realistic remote count/matching-buffer bypass demonstrated; use checked_count and compare in size_t.

hardening_observations.issue: Non-finite/out-of-int-range coordinates are not rejected before float-to-int conversion/DDA
hardening_observations.disposition: Actual mob/entity path limits distance to128, volume32768; malformed player coordinate injection not established. Reject non-finite inputs and enforce iteration bound.

Pathfinder nodes reserve max_nodes and reject additions beyond max_nodes, preserving references used during search; neighbor array length10 covers4 cardinal+4 diagonal+2 amphibious.
No raw lifetime handle is passed for these operations; pathfinder state lives in thread-local C++ owned containers.
Brain CSR entry validates offsets, memory IDs and statuses; packed path relies on Java plan construction.
Nested policy resolver returned empty output for entity, tick, heightmap, JNI scopes.
WorldgenHeightmap storage_longs metadata is populated but unused in kernels; not sufficient by itself to claim remote corruption.
Java PathfinderTickStateCache.begin ignores gameTime and only resets on level switch; MAX_CACHED_SECTIONS512 is local Java limit.
